newsitem.title: UK: UK's Halifax raises mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: UK's Halifax raises mortgage rates.

text.p: Halifax Plc, Britain's largest mortgage lender, said on Friday it was raising its standard variable mortgage rate to 8.45 percent from 8.20.
The increase will take immediate effect for new borrowers and be imposed on existing borrowers from September 1.

The Halifax said the move follows last Thursday's quarter-point increase in base rates, taking them to seven percent. It said savers' rates would also be increased on September 1, with details to follow shortly.
Following the increase, the monthly repayments on a 100,000 stg mortgage will increase by 19.91 pounds to 672.50. -- Mike Peacock, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7708
